title: Lunora registry item
description: Manifest (registry.json) for one `lunora add` item: the files it scaffolds plus the deps, bindings, env vars, and post-install guidance it needs.

$schema.description: Path/URL to this schema for editor validation.

name.description: Unique item identifier; must match the directory name.

title.description: Short human-readable label, distinct from the longer description.

description.description: Longer explanation of what the item provides.

requires.description: Other registry items this one depends on (resolved transitively, deps first).

deps.description: npm dependencies to add to the project package.json (name → version range).

devDependencies.description: npm devDependencies to add to the project package.json.

bindings.description: wrangler.jsonc additions, applied as structural edits.

envVars.description: Environment variables the item needs; scaffolded into .dev.vars on add.

value.description: Default/example value for a non-secret var.

secret.description: Secret: write only a placeholder and remind about `wrangler secret put`. Defaults true when no value is given.

docs.description: Post-install guidance printed after the item is added.

entrypointReexports.description: Worker-entry re-exports the item needs (class-B/C only). Each entry injects `export * from './lunora/<module>'` into the worker entry.

comment.description: Optional JS comment above the re-export line.

files.description: Files the item scaffolds into the project.

from.description: Source path inside the item directory (relative, no `..`).

to.description: Destination relative to the project root (relative, no `..`).

merge.description: `create-or-skip` writes whole files (lock-aware upgrades); `schema-extension` AST-merges into lunora/schema.ts.
